text:
Munich’s median asking rent stands at 23.23 €/m², the highest of the 37‑city sample, with a 3.0 % year‑on‑year rise and a 26.9 % gain over the past five years. The market remains tight, reflected by a 1.4 % vacancy rate and an average of 22 days on market; 34 % of listings are let within a week.

Affordability is pressured: a 60 m² unit costs about 1 394 € per month, and rent‑burden for two residents is 21.9 %. Asking rents sit roughly 80 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 12.89 €/m², underscoring the premium.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 24.44 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 23.71 €/m² and 24.95 €/m², implying a 5.2 % increase.
